Title: Public Preview: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager now supports placement drift detection and takeover

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager’s cluster resource placement has two new preview features to provide more control over placement conflict resolution.  

 

Using the new “applyStrategy”, an operator can define how Fleet Manager resolves conflicts when attempting to place a workload where a clashing workload exists and how to treat configuration drift of a placed workload. Additionally, using the new “ReportDiff” apply mode, an operator can inspect the drift state of a workload across all clusters on which it is deployed. 

Learn more:

  • Read "Taking over existing workloads with Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager cluster resource placement".
  • Read "Detecting and managing workload drift with Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager cluster resource placement".
